title: Housekeeping Supervisor
summary: Makes sure hotel guest rooms and public areas are clean, inspected and ready on time. Sits in the Rooms team under the executive housekeeper and leads room attendants, housemen and the linen room on a shift.
dailyDuties: Allocate rooms to attendants at the shift briefing
Inspect cleaned rooms and release them in the PMS
Supervise lobby, restroom and back-of-house cleaning
Count linen and amenities against par stock
Check chemical storage, dilution and staff safety gear
Log and store lost and found items
Prepare duty rosters for the housekeeping team

skills.expectation: Inspect cleaned rooms against the brand checklist and release them on time
Control linen, uniforms and guest amenities against par stock
Plan and supervise cleaning of the lobby, restrooms and back of house
Store, dilute and use cleaning chemicals safely and train staff on them
Record, store and return guest lost property by procedure
Update room status and discrepancies in the housekeeping module of the PMS
Make duty rosters and allocate rooms to attendants each shift
Lead and coach room attendants and housemen on the floor
Handle guest requests for amenities and room fixes
Coordinate laundry, pest control and cleaning vendors
Keep inventory and inspection records in Excel
Train new room attendants on cleaning steps
